1.explanation: This code uses Immer’s `produce` with its default auto-freeze behavior to generate a non-extensible (frozen) dataSource array and nested objects. Passing `frozenData` into `<CascaderSelect>` reproduces the error, because under the hood the component makes in-place changes to each node object (e.g. adding or resetting its `value` property), which fails on frozen objects and throws the TypeError shown in the bug report.
1.bug_scenario:
In a React app using Immer (with auto-freeze enabled) to manage the cascader dataSource, the returned state objects are non-extensible. When you pass this frozen dataSource into <CascaderSelect>, the component internally mutates the objects (for example, adding or resetting the `value` property), triggering an error:

“Uncaught TypeError: Cannot add property value, object is not extensible”

This screenshot shows the console error stack coming from cascader.js at the point where CascaderSelect tries to mutate the user’s data objects.
